plan.title: feat(dashboard): project-overview pipeline section redesign — fix badge/name overlap, one row per issue with titles, plain-language phases, per-issue cost
plan.author: overdeck/auto-start

narratives.Problem:
**Mockup (BINDING):** [`docs/design/mockups/project-overview-pipeline.html`](https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/blob/main/docs/design/mockups/project-overview-pipeline.html) · **PRD:** [`.pan/drafts/`](https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/tree/main/.pan/drafts) (backfilled)

## Problems (operator screenshot 2026-07-07, ProjectOverview.tsx)

1. **Overlap bug**: the 'REVIEW RUNNING'/'WORK RUNNING' badge renders ON TOP of the agent name ('REVIEW RUNNINGagent-pan-2095') — unreadable.
2. **No issue titles anywhere** in the pipeline rows — just PAN-XXXX ids, though `feature.title` is already in the component's data.
3. One row per AGENT instead of per ISSUE — multi-agent issues eat multiple title-less rows.
4. Raw jargon badges, truncated costs ('$28.8'), unclear red/initials avatars, no needs-you prominence.

## Redesign (per mockup)

- One row per issue: grid `[id | title+subline | phase chip + who-line | cost+sessions | avatar]` — collision structurally impossible.
- Title is the row's primary text (single line, ellipsized). Subline = plain-language state ('review passed · tests running now', 'N of M tasks').
- Phase chips reuse the cockpit's non-technical vocabulary and colors (building / in review / testing / waiting on you / lining up to ship). NEVER raw status text.
- **Needs-you group pinned first** (amber), then stage groups in pipeline order, rows by last activity.
- Cost right-aligned, full precision, with session count.
- Row click → issue cockpit. Keep the 5-stat strip + CI health card; make stat cards link through.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No text overlap at any viewport ≥1280px (Playwright screenshot check, both themes)
- [ ] Every pipeline row shows the issue title
- [ ] Multi-agent issues render as ONE row with a crew summary who-line
- [ ] Raw statuses ('WORK RUNNING' etc.) absent from the DOM; plain-language chips only
- [ ] Needs-you issues grouped first with amber accents
- [ ] Costs render unabbreviated with session counts
- [ ] Row click navigates to the issue cockpit
narratives.Proposal: Implement the issue directly from the tracker-provided title and body.
